status: Prespecified before Milestone 2 candidate fitting or final-test predictions

outer_split.algorithm: Exact Milestone 1: class-sorted unique-vector groups, default_rng shuffle, array_split into 5; fold0=test, fold1=threshold_validation, folds2-4=train

baseline: Training-majority DummyClassifier, not eligible for selecting the candidate model
selection: Maximal mean inner-fold macro-F1; ties within 1e-12 prefer logistic then smaller C; forest ties prefer smaller depth then larger leaves. No model choice uses threshold-validation or test metrics.

referral.score: Maximum class score, not claimed calibrated probability
referral.candidates: 0.0 plus each distinct validation score; complete score ties
referral.choice: Greatest accepted count, then smallest numeric cutoff; exhaustive scan because risk need not be monotonic
referral.no_feasible: Explicit refer_all, null threshold, zero coverage and undefined conditional error

test: Freeze fitted training-only model and validation policy before one final evaluation batch. Save a prediction table and derive every later test result/figure from that cache. Do not predict unselected candidates on test or refit on train plus validation.

bootstrap.method: Unstratified resampling of whole exact-feature groups with replacement, retaining all member-row multiplicities; frozen model and threshold; paired baseline comparison
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles; undefined conditional-error replicates counted and excluded only from that interval
bootstrap.scope: Conditional internal-collection uncertainty, not training/threshold-search uncertainty or external batch generalization

sensitivity: One-record-per-vector evaluation weighting using the same cached test predictions and frozen policy. No alternate test-tuned model. This does not test the training effect of duplicate retention.
figures: Validation error-coverage curve with frozen held-out operating point
Held-out per-variety referral burden and accepted errors
prohibited_claims: food safety or seed health certification
